notes.title: Ultimate Battle 1.1: CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.notes:
💡💡 Version 1.1 "Christmas Update"💡💡

✅ New dedicated Christmas-themed map [Temporary Exclusive].
✅ New Christmas-themed weapon [Temporary Exclusive].
✅ New Christmas-themed menu background
✅ New logo.
✅ Character name change.

Please note that the Christmas-themed update will start tomorrow 12/20/2020 and will end on 01/06/2021.

Stay tuned by following the Twitter page as well.

notes.title: [Announcement] 1 week to game release
notes.notes:
Get ready to take to the field, in 1 week, on December 17th at 17:00 GMT, the game will be released worldwide.

Tell your friends and add the game to your wish list.

Don't be caught unprepared.

notes.title: Working on the Christmas Update

And other interesting things will be added.

Stay tuned
